limits: Fixed source catalog is bounded, not a global inventory or arbitrary prompt/tool-output proof
Remote ledger/external tools are observations at read time; their domain controllers retain current-state and action authority
Unregistered local files, unisolated shell and cached prose are withheld from Memory model scopes; cwd/env are not OS filesystem isolation
Work managed file access still requires a formal source binding; owner upload does not grant Work permission
Non-Pi native web and legacy plan execute lack provenance/dispatch hooks and return explicit 422 recovery, not silent engine substitution
RAG is parsed derivation; managed artifact origin revocation blocks use but retains historical chunks; legacy cloud/null originals remain independently controlled parsed records
Dispatch revalidates each logical Pi request, cannot retract requests already sent, and does not prove model use or business success
Private local artifact quota remains 204800 bytes, zero-byte retirement fences retained, no cloud/private_blob/native deployment validated
Existing empty memoryTypes grant compatibility remains fail closed
Actual isolated synthetic PG/local IO/faux Pi only; no daily DB migration/reload, real model/business Work, message, money, cloud, mobile or native-specialty acceptance
